subject: Prelude of Light
text: Playing the Prelude of Light warps Link back to the Temple of Time.

evidence.quote: Play the Prelude of Light to warp back to the Temple of Time.

subject: Princess Zelda
text: Entering the Temple of Time triggers a cutscene revealing Princess Zelda as the Seventh Sage before she is captured by Ganondorf.

evidence.quote:
As soon as you enter the Temple of Time, a cutscene will take place.  Zelda's
whereabouts are finally revealed - but she is captured by Ganondorf seconds
later....The last big
revelation in this cutscene is that there is a Seventh Sage - the Sage of Time,
Princess Zelda.

subject: Princess Zelda
text: Princess Zelda gives Link the Light Arrows right before she is captured.

evidence.quote:
Zelda manages to give you the Light Arrows (the only weapon,
apart from the Master Sword, which can truly hurt him) just before she is
captured.

subject: Ganon's Castle
text: Heading for Ganon's Castle from the upper entrance of Hyrule Castle Market triggers the Sages to automatically form a bridge of light.

evidence.quote:
Once you're done deciding if you care about any of the above things, then head
for Ganon's Castle using the upper entrance in Hyrule Castle Market.  The Sages
will automatically create a bridge of light into the castle for you when you
near it's front entrance.

subject: Keep
text: The Keep has six branching hallways representing the six Sages, each containing a seal that must be destroyed to lower the shield around Ganon's Tower.

evidence.quote:
The Keep is a large central hub, with six hallways branching off from it.
Each hallway represents one of the six Sages and their alignments - Forest,
Fire, Water, Shadow, Spirit, and Light.  In each hallway, there is a seal which
must be destroyed, which will lower the shield surrounding the entrance to
Ganon's Tower in the center of the Keep.

subject: Entrance
text: Running down the stairs at the entrance and between the pair of Beamos statues leads through a door into the Keep.

evidence.quote:
Run down the stairs as you enter the dungeon.  At the bottom of the flight of
stairs, run right between the pair of Beamos statues and through the door.

subject: Keep
text: Going right upon entering the Keep leads to a door with the Forest Medallion emblazoned above it.

evidence.quote:
Go right as you enter the Keep, and you will reach a door with the Forest
Medallion emblazoned above it.  Go through this door.

subject: Gray Wolfos
text: In Forest Seal Room One, stepping into the middle of the room spawns a Gray Wolfos, which can be defeated by backflipping away from its attack and jump attacking its back.

evidence.quote:
Step into the middle of the room, and a Gray Wolfos will appear.  Defeat it in
the usual fashion (wait for it to attack, backflip out of the way, then Jump
Attack when it's back is turned).

subject: Chest
text: Defeating the Gray Wolfos in Forest Seal Room One spawns a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: A chest will appear, which contains a Blue Rupee.

subject: Sealed door
text: In Forest Seal Room One, using Din's Fire on the carpet lights four surrounding torches, and shooting a Fire Arrow at the torch above the sealed door unseals it.

evidence.quote:
Stand on the carpeting in the middle of the room, and use Din's Fire to
light the four torches surrounding the carpet.  Next, use a Fire Arrow to light
the torch above the sealed door.  The door will unseal itself.

subject: Block of Time
text: Playing the Song of Time when Navi flutters beneath the Silver Rupee above the pit causes a Block of Time to appear.

evidence.quote:
As you enter, look to the left to see a Silver Rupee
hanging above a pit.  Navi will flutter down underneath the Silver Rupee; play
the Song of Time when she does this, and a Block of Time will appear.

subject: Block of Time
text: Equipping the Iron Boots stops the fan from blowing Link around while walking out onto the Block of Time to grab the Silver Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Equip the Iron Boots to keep the fan from blowing you around, and then walk out
onto the Block of Time to take the rupee.

subject: Hover Boots
text: Running toward the left ledge with Hover Boots while the fan blows carries Link across the room on the wind.

evidence.quote:
Wait for the fan to stop blowing,
then switch to the Hover Boots.  Stand still and wait for the fan to start
blowing again.  Run towards the ledge on the left side of the room when this
happens, and the fan's wind will blow you to the ledge.

subject: Beamos
text: Tossing a bomb over to the Beamos statue destroys it.

evidence.quote:
Switch back to the Kokiri Boots, and toss a bomb over to the Beamos statue to
destroy it.

subject: Beamos platform
text: Jumping to the vacated Beamos platform allows Link to reach the right side of the room to collect another Silver Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Jump out to the Beamos statue's vacated platform, then go to the right side of
the room to gather another Silver Rupee.

subject: Fan platform
text: Climbing to the sealed door and waiting for the right fan to stop blowing allows Link to jump out and grab a Silver Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Climb up to the front of the sealed door, and look to the right to see another
Silver Rupee in front of a fan.  Wait for the fan to stop blowing, then jump out
to grab the Silver Rupee.

subject: Switch
text: Jumping down to the platform beneath the fan on the left of the sealed door and stepping on the switch makes a Longshot statue appear beneath the high Silver Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Look to the left of the sealed door, and there is another fan.  Beneath the fan
is another platform, with a switch on it.  Wait for the fan to stop blowing,
then jump down to the switch.  Stand on it, and a Longshot statue will appear
beneath that single Silver Rupee we couldn't reach before.

subject: Sealed door
text: Longshooting up to the statue and grabbing the Silver Rupee unseals the door on the opposite side of the room.

evidence.quote:
Longshot yourself
up to the statue, and then grab the Silver Rupee.  The sealed door on the other
side of the room will unseal itself.
